title: Title & Registration Services Extension Tags: Allowance by Lender Behind the Purchase
content:
On a Title & Registration Services order, the extension lien allowance is five days when an outside lender's proceeds were posted to the purchase order, two days when Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds were posted to it and no outside lender's proceeds were, and nothing otherwise. The allowance is a waiting allowance added, in whole days, on top of an extension tag's base validity.

The postings are read from the payment entries on the purchase order's ledger under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, by their source of funds: outside lender proceeds, or Kestrel finance proceeds.

| Outside lender proceeds posted to the purchase order | Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds posted to the purchase order | Lien allowance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | 5 days |
| no | yes | 2 days |
| no | no | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A purchase paid with a down payment and Kestrel finance proceeds: 2 days.
- A purchase paid with a down payment and outside lender proceeds: 5 days.
- A purchase paid entirely from the buyer's own funds: nothing.
